gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
Please could you look ___ my plants while I'm away?
The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).
